description.value: The Stock Market has operated from stall 147 in Vancouver's Granville Island Public Market since 1986, selling freshly made soups, stocks, pestos, sauces, and dressings crafted from local ingredients. It is a well-known local institution in one of BC's most popular cycling-accessible urban destinations. Touring cyclists exploring Granville Island will find it tucked in the far east corner of the Public Market.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (100 spaces) at 51m; rack at 75m. Total: 100 spaces.
